duration.text: The Journalism and Communication Studies at Fudan University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 13750 USD/per year ￥ 99000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Transcript of undergraduate school5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.6.Organizational Chart Organizational chart indicating the current position held by the candidate7.Signed Statement Personal Statement with the applicant\'s signature, written in Chinese or in English.8.Official GMAT Report Official GMAT Report sent by the test center (if applicable)

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens2. No criminal record3. Bachelor's degree or above
